# GenAI Career Intelligence System

> Evidence-graded knowledge and guidance for GenAI careers, across the whole lifecycle: which roles exist, where their work sits and which are best; what each role needs (every concept, tool and soft skill, tiered and evidence-tagged); how to prove it, get seen, pass the interview loop, evaluate and negotiate an offer and start well; tracks for transitions, India-based remote work, visas, independent practice and governance careers; and the 22 research sessions behind it all. Every empirical claim carries an EGP-1.0 grade (A/B measured, C small-sample or vendor, D judgement, M model output, P practice-curated) and a date.

How to use this repository:

- Start at career/README.md (Start Here) or a stage README; each stage README links its guides and its graded research findings.
- Facts live once: machine-readable sources of truth are in data/, and the generated documents are rebuilt from them by scripts/.
- Research sessions are dated snapshots (October 2026): check research/ERRATA.md and each claim's date before relying on a figure.
- Rules for agents that edit or answer from this repository are in AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [Start Here: Navigate a GenAI Career](career/README.md): Entry point to the career content: start from your situation or your question, see the map of GenAI roles, follow the lifecycle stages, or take the path for your background. Every page links back to graded evidence.
- [Research Layer: Sessions, Findings, Decisions and Errata](research/README.md): Index of the evidence layer: the 22 Phase 0 research sessions, the findings registry distilled from them, the decision registry, the Founding Architecture Document, errata and how to add research.
- [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md): What is covered, what is planned next, and the open decisions.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Rules for AI agents: sources of truth, evidence standard, generators and validation.

## Stage 00: Start-here tools

- [Stage 00: Start-here tools](career/00-start/README.md): Index of stage 00 (start-here tools): the workbook, glossary and tool catalog that help at every stage of a GenAI career search, plus a personal script that turns your skill ratings into a gap report.
- [Glossary: Terms, Codes and Acronyms Used in This Repository](career/00-start/glossary.md): Plain one-line definitions of the evidence codes, role and skill terms, and the hiring, pay, India, visa and governance vocabulary used across the repository, each linked to a page that uses it, so a newcomer or an AI agent can read any page.
- [Targeting Workbook: From Point Zero to a Ranked Target List and a 90-Day Plan](career/00-start/targeting-workbook.md): A fill-in workbook from point zero to a ranked target list: score readiness on 12 skills, set constraints and a pay floor against measured anchors, score a shortlist, place it in primary, adjacent and stretch rings, and write a 90-day plan judged by gate G1.
- [Career Tool Catalog: What to Use, Use With Care, Avoid or Watch](career/00-start/tool-catalog.md): 132 external career tools and platforms across the lifecycle, each with a verdict (use, use with care, avoid, watch), the evidence behind it, its source and the date it was checked.

## Stage 01: Landscape

- [Stage 01: Landscape](career/01-landscape/README.md): Index of stage 01 (landscape): What does the GenAI job market look like, globally and in India?
- [Emerging GenAI Roles: How to Read a New Job Title](career/01-landscape/emerging-roles.md): How to read a new GenAI job title (a real role, a skill inside an existing role, or unproven hype): the seven graduation tests in plain words, a dated watchlist of emerging, candidate and quarantined titles, what would change each status, and how to use emerging terms honestly on a résumé.
- [The GenAI Employer Landscape: Six Employer Types and How Each Hires, Interviews, Pays and Onboards](career/01-landscape/employer-landscape.md): One employer taxonomy for the GenAI job market as of October 2026: six types (frontier labs, Big Tech, AI-native startups by stage, enterprises and GCCs, IT services, public sector), each mapped to how it hires, interviews, pays, onboards and weighs credentials, plus a matrix and a career-stage chooser.
- [The GenAI Job Market in October 2026: What It Looks Like and What It Means for You](career/01-landscape/market-overview.md): What the GenAI job market looks like as of October 2026, globally and in India: which titles have measured volume, where demand, pay and applicant pressure sit, what is short and what is commoditised, and the decision rules that follow for each kind of job seeker.

## Stage 02: Roles

- [Stage 02: Roles](career/02-roles/README.md): Index of stage 02 (roles): Which GenAI roles exist, which are the best, and which should I target?
- [Role Hubs: One Page per Role](career/02-roles/hubs/README.md): Index of the 29 role hubs: one generated page per canonical role with its definition, footprint, graded scores, skills, proof, interview track and résumé pointers.
- [GenAI Target Roles: The Sorted Shortlist](career/02-roles/genai-target-roles.md): Which GenAI roles to target, in order: a sorted shortlist from a consensus of eight lenses restricted to GenAI demand, with the tier rules, one line per role, and a method for choosing one cluster, its top title and two adjacent titles.
- [GenAI Role Master Catalog](career/02-roles/role-catalog.md): All 29 canonical GenAI roles and 241 classified job titles: role profiles, evidence status and volumes, aliases, the quarantine register of speculative titles, and an A-Z title index.
- [The GenAI Role Map: Where the Work Sits](career/02-roles/role-map.md): Where each GenAI role's work sits: six stack layers from compute to applications, four cross-cutting planes, every role's footprint, the specialisations inside roles, and how to choose a direction. A map, not a pay model.
- [Role Rankings: The Composite Career Index (All Demand)](career/02-roles/role-rankings.md): Evidence-weighted ranking of the GenAI roles on all demand for each title (CCI): pillar scores with uncertainty ranges, Monte Carlo ranks, weight sensitivity, goal, persona and India lenses, and a dossier per role.

## Stage 03: Skills and technology

- [Stage 03: Skills and technology](career/03-skills-and-tech/README.md): Index of stage 03 (skills and technology): What exactly does each role need me to know and use, and how much does each skill matter?
- [Agentic Protocols: MCP, A2A and AG-UI at the Depth Your Role Needs](career/03-skills-and-tech/agentic-protocols.md): What MCP, A2A and AG-UI are and their dated status as of October 2026, what to know at each depth (awareness, build, operate) for your role, how employers ask for protocol skills, the security essentials, and how to prove the skill.
- [Learning Roadmaps: What to Learn, in What Order, and How Long It Takes](career/03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md): How to learn what a target GenAI role needs: the order by role family and starting background, how long it takes at 8–10, 15–20 or 35–40 hours a week, the four gates that prove progress, and where to spend hours (durable concepts) versus pin and wait (fast-moving tools).
- [GenAI Role Skill Inventories](career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-inventories.md): Index of the complete typed skill inventory per role, with cross-role views for universal and family resumes, the tier decisions, verification, and the requirements and tier rule behind the skills ontology.
- [Role Skill Maps](career/03-skills-and-tech/role-skill-maps.md): Narrative skill map for every role: practice notes from the evidence, tools in use with their October 2026 status, proof of work, interview track, typical gaps and entry routes. Each role's skills and tiers are in its generated inventory.
- [GenAI Skills Radar: Learn First, Differentiate, Specialise, Replace](career/03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md): What to learn first, what sets each résumé family apart, which skills only one or two roles demand, and what to stop investing in, computed from the skills ontology for the 24 individual-contributor roles.
- [GenAI Skills Vocabulary](career/03-skills-and-tech/skills-vocabulary.md): Every skill in the ontology, typed (concept, method, language, framework, tool, platform, non-technical), with posting wording, relations, alternatives, status and corpus mentions.

## Stage 04: Certifications

- [Stage 04: Certifications](career/04-certifications/README.md): Index of stage 04 (certifications): Is a certificate worth it for my target role and hiring channel?
- [Credential ROI: Whether a Certificate Is Worth It, Which One, and How to Show It](career/04-certifications/credential-roi.md): Whether a certificate is worth it for your target role and hiring channel, which one to take, how to show it on a résumé and LinkedIn, and when to stop, with the dated events behind current, retired and renamed credentials.
- [Credentials by Role](career/04-certifications/credentials-by-role.md): Which certifications the evidence lists for each GenAI role, at which tier, and each credential's dated status, generated from the skills ontology.

## Stage 05: Portfolio

- [Stage 05: Portfolio](career/05-portfolio/README.md): Index of stage 05 (portfolio): What should I build to prove I can do the job?
- [Project Archetypes: Proof-of-Work Projects, Specified](career/05-portfolio/project-archetypes.md): The 20 proof-of-work project archetypes as build cards: the problem, the steps, the evidence to publish, the verifiability target, effort, the interviews each prepares for, pitfalls, and the roles it covers.
- [Proof-of-Work Standards: What a GenAI Portfolio Must Show to Be Believed](career/05-portfolio/proof-of-work-standards.md): What a GenAI portfolio must show to be believed at your target level: the verifiability ladder (V0–V3), the 15 artefacts by tier, the nine anti-portfolio patterns and their fixes, how many projects to keep, and how to harden a public demo.

## Stage 06: Job search

- [Stage 06: Job search and applications](career/06-job-search/README.md): Index of stage 06 (job search and applications): How do I find postings, apply well and get past the screens?
- [Application Operating System: Tracker, Weekly Rhythm, Funnel Metrics and When to Change Course](career/06-job-search/application-operating-system.md): A weekly operating system for running a job search: a fill-in tracker, a weekly rhythm, funnel metrics with graded benchmarks and thresholds, and rules for when to change targets, résumé, channel or hours.
- [ATS Mechanics: How Applicant Tracking and AI Screening Work](career/06-job-search/ats-mechanics.md): How applicant tracking systems and AI screening layers handle an application, which myths to ignore, and the exact rules for a portal résumé and knockout answers that parse cleanly and pass.
- [Channels and Boards: Where GenAI Postings Are and Which Channels Convert](career/06-job-search/channels-and-boards.md): Where GenAI postings are listed and which channels turn applications into offers: referrals, sourcing, cold inbound, ATS-hosted boards, aggregators, specialist boards and India platforms, with alert setup and a scam and ghost-job check.
- [GenAI Job-Search Strategy: Hiring Levers, Binding Constraints and Sequencing](career/06-job-search/job-search-strategy.md): First-principles job-search strategy: the four levers that turn an application into an offer, the constraints that bind before the number of résumés does (proof of work, maintenance, interview tracks, one application per company), and how to sequence targets in expanding rings.
- [GenAI Resume Skills Matrix](career/06-job-search/resume-skills-matrix.md): The concise skills section for every role (Must / Important / Should / Optional headline skills), shared skills across roles, and a skills-section blueprint per resume variant.
- [GenAI Résumé Strategy: One Master Inventory, Layered Résumés, Light Tailoring](career/06-job-search/resume-strategy.md): How to run résumés for many GenAI roles: one private master inventory, one universal résumé, two or three variants from a catalogue of 15, light tailoring per posting, and the computed decisions on which roles need a résumé of their own.

## Stage 07: Networking

- [Stage 07: Networking and visibility](career/07-networking/README.md): Index of stage 07 (networking and visibility): How do I get referred, and what do recruiters find when they search for me?
- [Communities Guide: Which AI-Engineering Communities Are Worth Your Time](career/07-networking/communities-guide.md): Which AI-engineering communities are worth a standing weekly budget, how to take part so that it builds a reputation, and when to quit one, with a tiered directory of global and India venues as of 21 October 2026.
- [Online Presence: What Recruiters and Hiring Managers Find When They Look You Up](career/07-networking/online-presence.md): What recruiters and hiring managers find when they look you up on LinkedIn, GitHub and a blog or portfolio site, and how to make those surfaces consistent with your résumé and checkable in minutes.
- [Referrals and Outreach: Getting Pulled In by a Named Human](career/07-networking/referrals-and-outreach.md): How to get referred and how to reach hiring managers, founders and maintainers with an artefact they can verify: who to contact, what to send, how often, when to stop, and when open source is worth it, with the evidence and its limits.

## Stage 08: Interviewing

- [Stage 08: Interviewing](career/08-interviewing/README.md): Index of stage 08 (interviewing): How do I pass the interview loop for my track?
- [Behavioural Calibration: How GenAI Behavioural Rounds Are Scored and How to Build a Story Bank](career/08-interviewing/behavioral-calibration.md): How behavioural rounds are scored in GenAI hiring, the four competencies that decide them, and how to build a STAR-AI story bank that survives a round where one No Hire can veto the loop.
- [Coding Rounds in GenAI Loops: Classic, AI-Enabled, Document Review and Debugging](career/08-interviewing/coding-rounds.md): The coding-round formats reported in GenAI loops (classic, AI-enabled, design-document review and p95 latency debugging), what each one scores, and how to prepare for them without memorising solutions.
- [Interview Loops: Classify Your GenAI Loop, Prepare Each Round, Run the Day and Follow Up](career/08-interviewing/interview-loops.md): How GenAI interview loops are structured, how to classify yours before you prepare, what each round tests, what to do on the day, and how to debrief and follow up, with recruiter questions, templates and questions to ask your interviewers.
- [Interview Prep Packs: Practice Prompts by Track](career/08-interviewing/prep-packs.md): 57 practice prompts for the GenAI interview tracks, each with what a strong answer covers, the red flags interviewers note, the roles it applies to and its source; plus the 15 system-design archetypes.
- [GenAI System-Design Interviews: 15 Archetypes, the 45-Minute Blueprint, the Numbers and the Rubrics](career/08-interviewing/system-design-archetypes.md): How to prepare for and run a GenAI system-design round: classify the loop, drill the right archetypes out of 15, run the 45-minute blueprint, compute the numbers that change the design, and meet the evaluation, safety and Staff-level rubrics.

## Stage 09: Compensation

- [Stage 09: Compensation and negotiation](career/09-compensation/README.md): Index of stage 09 (compensation and negotiation): Is this offer good, and how do I negotiate it?
- [India Remote Tax: Structure, Thresholds and Traps for Engineers Paid by Foreign Clients](career/09-compensation/india-remote-tax.md): For India-based engineers paid directly by US, EU or UK clients: which structure fits which billing level, the ₹75 lakh presumptive-tax cliff, GST and the LUT, FEMA export reporting, client forms and the EOR trade-off, as dated pointers rather than tax advice.
- [Negotiation Playbook: Phases, Scripts, Levers and Counter-Moves for a GenAI Offer](career/09-compensation/negotiation-playbook.md): How to negotiate a GenAI offer in six phases: fill-in scripts for the expectations question, the counter email, a competing offer and a deadline extension; the 12 levers and when each moves; and if-then replies to the employer's counter-moves.
- [Offer Evaluation: Valuing Cash, Liquid Equity and Paper Equity Before You Sign](career/09-compensation/offer-evaluation.md): How to put GenAI offers on one cash-equivalent basis (base, bonus, liquid equity and discounted paper equity, adjusted for vesting, liquidity and non-financial terms), decide whether a move beats staying, and run equity due diligence before you sign.
- [Pay Benchmarks: What GenAI Roles Pay by Title, City, Level and Employer](career/09-compensation/pay-benchmarks.md): Measured pay for GenAI roles by title, city, level and employer type as of October 2026, with the source, date and grade of every figure, and the rules for reading pay data without being misled.

## Stage 10: Onboarding

- [Stage 10: Onboarding and the first 90 days](career/10-onboarding/README.md): Index of stage 10 (onboarding and the first 90 days): How do I pass probation and keep growing?
- [First 90 Days: Close the Expectations Gap and Pass Probation in a GenAI Role](career/10-onboarding/first-90-days.md): How to pass probation in a GenAI role: score the expectations gap in weeks 1–2, ship the 13 weekly artefacts of a 30-60-90 plan, get a scorecard confirmed by day 14, report variance upward and escalate by written rules.
- [Growth and Progression: Promotion, Moving On, IC or Manager, and Sustainable Learning](career/10-onboarding/growth-and-progression.md): After the first 90 days: how promotion and levelling pay in GenAI careers, when a move beats staying, how to choose between the IC and manager tracks, and how to keep learning at a pace you can sustain.

## Stage 11: Tracks and transitions

- [Stage 11: Tracks and transitions](career/11-tracks/README.md): Index of stage 11 (tracks and transitions): What changes for my background, location or way of working?
- [Career Transitions into GenAI: Roadmaps from Five Starting Backgrounds](career/11-tracks/career-transitions.md): Roadmaps into GenAI from five starting backgrounds: what transfers, what to learn and unlearn, modelled months to a first offer, quarterly plans, and the gates that show whether you are on track.
- [Freelance and Fractional AI Work: Rates, Income Reality, Clients and Contracts](career/11-tracks/freelance-fractional.md): Whether to go independent as an AI consultant or fractional Head of AI: dated rates and modelled income, the prerequisites to check first, a network-first client plan, retainer and contract terms to hold, and the stop rules for a practice that stalls.
- [Governance Careers: Entering AI Governance, Risk and Assurance](career/11-tracks/governance-careers.md): Entering AI governance, risk and assurance from GRC, privacy, audit, legal, security or ML engineering: the career families regulation has created, their real volumes, entry routes by background, and the proof and credentials worth having.
- [India Remote Playbook: Routes from India to US and EU Work](career/11-tracks/india-remote-playbook.md): For India-based engineers who want US or EU work: how to choose between a GCC job, remote employment through an EOR, direct contracting and relocation, how to find the work from India, what each route pays, and what to set up before the first offer or invoice.
- [PhD to Industry: Research and Applied Routes into GenAI](career/11-tracks/phd-to-industry.md): For PhDs and academic researchers moving into GenAI: which role to target, the engineering gap that decides offers, an 8-week skills block, fellowships, modelled timelines, and how a research record maps to O-1A evidence.
- [Visa and Relocation: Talent-Visa Corridors for AI Professionals](career/11-tracks/visa-and-relocation.md): Which talent-visa and employer-offer routes fit an AI professional, with depth for Indian nationals: what evidence each needs, how long and how much it takes, whether to relocate at all, and what to verify before acting. Not legal advice.

## Research

- [Research Findings Registry](research/findings.md): Every key finding of the 22 research sessions, with its evidence grade and exact line, grouped by lifecycle stage and by session.
- [Research Errata: Known Errors in the Phase 0 Research Records](research/ERRATA.md): Errors found in the sealed Phase 0 records (FAD, DECISIONS, T0-03, T0-06, T0-17, T1-01, T1-03, T2-01) and the correct reading, with evidence. Read before relying on those files.
- [Research Pipeline 2: Targeted Sessions for Every High-Impact Element](research/pipeline-2/README.md): The second research pipeline: 53 targeted sessions on networking, résumés, job search, certifications, countries and visas, remote work, pay, interviews and every role, each designed backwards from the data and pages it feeds, with a shared protocol, verification, integration and a generated tracker.
- [research/sessions/](research/sessions/): The 22 research sessions (dated evidence reports with source ledgers).
- [research/DECISIONS.md](research/DECISIONS.md): Architecture decision registry (D-001 to D-021).

## Research sessions

Session IDs cited across the repository (for example T0-04 L120) map to these files:

- [T0-01](research/sessions/T0-01-genai-role-taxonomy-market-volume.md): GenAI role taxonomy and live market volume: which titles clear a 50-posting quorum (Oct 2026) (2026-10-21)
- [T0-02](research/sessions/T0-02-global-regional-compensation-benchmarks.md): Global & Regional Compensation Benchmarks for GenAI Roles — US, Europe, India, GCC, Singapore, Remote (October 2026) (2026-10-21)
- [T0-03](research/sessions/T0-03-skills-compute-infra-eval-stack.md): Skills, Compute Frameworks & Evaluation Tooling: What Separates Commoditized GenAI App Developers from High-Earning Production Engineers (October 2026) (2026-10-24)
- [T0-04](research/sessions/T0-04-ats-filtering-funnel-conversion-math.md): ATS parsing, AI screening layers and cold-inbound funnel math for GenAI engineering resumes (October 2026) (2026-10-23)
- [T0-05](research/sessions/T0-05-unconventional-hiring-tactics-oss-audits.md): Unconventional hiring tactics for GenAI roles, late 2026: OSS contributions, public micro-audits, targeted outreach (2026-10-23)
- [T0-06](research/sessions/T0-06-career-transition-timelines-5-backgrounds.md): Career Transition Timelines, Skill Deltas and Quarterly Roadmaps: Five Starting Backgrounds into GenAI (Oct 2026) (2026-10-21)
- [T0-07](research/sessions/T0-07-india-remote-tax-statutory-compliance.md): India-based software/AI engineers paid directly by US/EU/UK clients: optimal legal, statutory and tax structure (position as at 21 October 2026) (2026-10-21)
- [T0-08](research/sessions/T0-08-global-talent-visa-relocation-pathways.md): Global talent-visa relocation pathways for Indian AI engineers: evidentiary and policy audit (October 2026) (2026-10-21)
- [T0-09](research/sessions/T0-09-onboarding-probation-first-90-days.md): GenAI engineer first 90 days (2026): the expectations gap, probation rubrics and a 30-60-90 operating playbook (2026-10-23)
- [T0-10](research/sessions/T0-10-career-tooling-ecosystem-12-stage-funnel.md): Career Tooling Ecosystem Audit: Evidence-Graded Map of the 12-Stage Career Funnel (October 2026) (2026-10-21)
- [T0-11](research/sessions/T0-11-certification-cloud-credential-roi.md): Commercial AI/ML certifications and cloud-credential ROI for GenAI hiring (October 2026) (2026-10-21)

- [T0-14](research/sessions/T0-14-ai-system-design-interview-patterns.md): AI System Design Interview Loops (Oct 2026): 15 Archetypes, a 45-Minute Blueprint, Calculation Formulas, Eval/Safety Rubric, and Senior-vs-Staff Differentiators (2026-10-21)
- [T0-15](research/sessions/T0-15-regulatory-ai-governance-career-families.md): Regulatory AI-governance career families, October 2026: what the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, India's DPDP Act and US executive orders actually produced (2026-10-23)
- [T0-16](research/sessions/T0-16-agentic-protocol-stack-enterprise-demand.md): Agentic Protocol Stack (MCP / A2A / ACP / AG-UI): Standardization Status and Enterprise Hiring Demand, October 2026 (2026-10-21)

## Data

- [data/role_scores.json](data/role_scores.json): Role facts and scoring inputs: each role's definition, work footprint and interview track, and every pillar score with its [lo, mid, hi] range, evidence grade and sourced basis
- [data/skills_ontology.json](data/skills_ontology.json): The skills ontology: 523 typed skills, choose-one classes, credentials, resume variants, every role's tiered, evidence-tagged skill links and the register of devalued skills
- [data/posting_skill_shares.json](data/posting_skill_shares.json): Dated snapshots of the skills job postings name, by posting title (JobsPipe, Grade B), cited by the role links in the ontology
- [data/role_titles.json](data/role_titles.json): The A–Z index of posting titles: each title's index type and the canonical role it maps to
- [data/project_archetypes.json](data/project_archetypes.json): Proof-of-work project archetypes: the problem, build steps, evidence to publish, verifiability target, interview archetypes, pitfalls and the skills each one evidences
- [data/interview_prompts.json](data/interview_prompts.json): Interview practice prompts keyed to interview tracks, system-design archetypes, roles and skills, with what a strong answer covers
- [data/tools.json](data/tools.json): External career tools and platforms by stage, with a verdict, evidence grade, source and date
- [data/stack_model.json](data/stack_model.json): The stack map: six layers, four cross-cutting planes, the skill-category map and the specialisations inside roles (decision D-015)
- [data/findings.json](data/findings.json): Key findings of every research session, with grade, exact line and lifecycle stages
- [data/manifest.json](data/manifest.json): This manifest: every document with its front matter and section headings
- [data/schemas/](data/schemas/): JSON Schemas for the data files and for document front matter

- [CHARTER.md](CHARTER.md): Vision, scope and what the repository is not, audience, success criteria and constraints
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history
